exposure: Patients who had a subsequent vaginal delivery
cohort: Patients with previous obstetric anal sphincter injuries (OASIs) between 2010 and 2016
finding: The majority of patients followed parturition mode recommendations, resulting in a low recurrence of OASIs but a high cesarean section rate.
mod_finding: Adherence to parturition mode recommendations after obstetric anal sphincter injuries, which included a high rate of Cesarean section, resulted in a low recurrence of injuries.
